raw_text: ALERT: PLA infrastructure buildup at Pangong Tso confirmed via multiple satellite passes. New bridge construction at Finger 8 area. This follows the pattern of incremental infrastructure development we have tracked since 2020. Chinese forces are creating permanent logistics connectivity that was previously absent. Recommend monitoring for vehicle movement across the new structure in coming weeks. Sources indicate additional road widening activity on the Chinese side approaching the bridge.
